decisions.reason: The source selects 5V for the current backlight build and leaves only an unpopulated 3.3V fallback footprint; it does not change the DCDC1 rail or its existing 3.3V loads.
The backlight remains within the existing system power path and uses an already-required 5V rail, so the AXP2101 power-source and rail requirements remain unchanged.
The candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the backlight supply, switching, PWM control, component population, decoupling, and current requirements.
The current backlight build uses 5V; the unpopulated 3.3V jumper is only a future fallback and does not change the current standalone USB 3.3V supply requirement.
The external e-paper backlight is independent of the SK6812 and dedicated interfaces used to display battery-charge status.
The monitoring requirement already covers the complete 5V rail; adding a backlight load does not change the monitored rails, monitor device, or measurement topology.
The backlight circuit and its GPIO42 PWM control do not alter the panel-mounted button or AXP2101 PWRON behavior.
The source specifies the external backlight circuit and does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal assembly requirement.
The source does not discuss or alter the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The backlight load specification does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or other electrical protection requirements.
The source does not change the battery NTC terminal, connector, controller, or thermal-protection behavior.
The J_DISP_LED backlight interface is separate from the external sensor connector fanout and does not alter any sensor-module connector.
